about: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Limited is an India-based luxury food services company providing curated culinary experiences. Its integrated business model encompasses events catering, casual dining restaurants & cloud kitchens, and banquets and integrated F&B services. As of September 2026, it operates six centralized kitchens across India and one in Dubai, catering to high-profile events domestically and internationally.

promoters.background: Sanjay Manohar Vazirani is the Chairman and Managing Director, having over three decades of experience in conceptualizing, executing, developing and expanding luxury catering, food and beverages business in India and UAE.

concentration.note: Repeat customers who availed services in at least two of the last three fiscal years were 214 in FY26, 309 in FY25, and 180 in FY24.

litigation_note: The company, directors, promoter, and KMPs have outstanding litigations pending against them which, if determined adversely, could result in material liability, damage payments, and expenses.
strengths: India's largest player by revenue in Fiscal 2025 among peers in organized ultra-luxury and luxury catering.
Integrated, complementary business model spanning luxury events catering, casual dining restaurants, cloud kitchens, and banqueting services.
Centralized kitchen hub-and-spoke infrastructure across key metro cities providing consistent culinary quality and operational scalability.
Diversified geographic footprint with operations across India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and Malaysia.
Proven track record of serving marquee clients with 214 repeat customers in Fiscal 2026.
Experienced promoter and professional leadership team possessing over three decades of culinary and hospitality domain experience.

risks.title: Unidentified locations for expansion objects
risks.detail: Locations for the proposed centralized kitchen, two banquets, and four casual dining restaurants funded by IPO proceeds have not yet been identified.

risks.title: Unplaced orders for capital expenditure
risks.detail: No firm orders or contracts have been placed for capex items for the proposed kitchen, banquets, and restaurants, risking delays and cost overruns.

risks.title: Past history of operational losses
risks.detail: The company incurred a restated loss of ₹15.35 crore in Fiscal 2024 and ₹16.15 crore for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026.

risks.title: Frequent store and kitchen closures
risks.detail: The group shut down 11 casual dining restaurants and 10 cloud kitchens between April 1, 2023 and the RHP date.

risks.title: High concentration in events catering
risks.detail: Events catering generated 52.89% of revenue in FY26 and 54.26% in FY25, exposing results to cyclical and seasonal demand shocks.

risks.title: Subsidiaries generating zero revenue
risks.detail: Subsidiaries including Foodlink Global Limited and Foodlink Global Restaurants and Catering Services Limited have not generated standalone revenue in Fiscals 2024 to 2026.

risks.title: Restrictive covenants and debt servicing
risks.detail: Borrowing facilities stipulate strict covenants including Current Ratio over 1.10 and TOL/TNW under 3.50; failure triggers penal charges or accelerated repayment.

risks.title: Extensive reliance on leased properties
risks.detail: All centralized kitchens, banquets, and dining locations operate on leasehold premises, exposing operations to non-renewal and rental escalation risks.

notes: Consolidated restated financial information. The stub period for the six months ended September 30, 2026 has been excluded from the financial arrays.
